proceedings.supporting_quote: In a judgment of 20 November 2000, the court declared the applicant to be partially incapacitated

proceedings.deciding_body: Veliko Tarnovo Court of Appeal ( Апелативен съд )
proceedings.supporting_quote: That judgment was upheld in a judgment of 12 April 2001 by the Veliko Tarnovo Court of Appeal
on 23 May 2002 the Municipal Council appointed Ms R.P., a council officer, as the applicant’s guardian
On 10 December 2002 a welfare-placement agreement was signed between R.P. and the social care home
On 10 August 2005 the regional prosecutor refused to bring an action for restoration of the applicant’s legal capacity
In a letter of 16 September 2005, the mayor of Rila refused his request
the regional prosecutor’s refusal was upheld on 11 October 2005 by the appellate prosecutor
subsequently on 29 November 2005 by the Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation
The Dupnitsa District Court gave judgment on 10 March 2006... the court dismissed the application
